description: This file defines the MockHandler class in the GuzzleHttp library; it implements a request handler that returns predefined responses or exceptions for testing purposes.

classes.name: MockHandler
classes.description: A handler that returns queued responses, callables, or exceptions, used primarily for testing Guzzle HTTP client interactions.

methods.name: createWithMiddleware
methods.description: Creates a HandlerStack with a new MockHandler instance, optionally initialized with a queue and callbacks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MockHandler with an optional queue, and optional onFulfilled and onRejected callbacks.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles an incoming request and returns a promise of the queued response or exception, simulating network responses.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds response objects, exceptions, callables, or promises to the queue.

methods.name: getLastRequest
methods.description: Returns the last request object received.

methods.name: getLastOptions
methods.description: Returns the options used in the last request.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of remaining queued responses or mock responses.
